input: Schedule a parent-teacher conference for next week

gold.taskTitle: Schedule a parent-teacher conference next week
gold.taskDescription: Arrange a parent-teacher conference meeting to take place sometime next week.

questions.title: Which child is this conference for?
questions.description: Identify the specific child or children whose teacher needs to be contacted.

questions.title: Which teacher or teachers need to attend?
questions.description: Determine whether this involves one subject teacher, a homeroom teacher, or multiple staff.

questions.title: What is the main topic or concern to discuss?
questions.description: Understand the purpose of the meeting, such as academic performance, behavior, or a general check-in.

questions.title: What days next week work best for you?
questions.description: Identify the parent's available days to narrow down scheduling options.

questions.title: What time of day do you prefer to meet?
questions.description: Determine whether the parent prefers a morning, afternoon, or after-school slot.

questions.title: Will this be in-person or a virtual meeting?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred format so the right logistics can be arranged.

questions.title: Do you have the teacher's contact details already?
questions.description: Check whether the parent needs to look up contact information or already has it to reach out directly.
